title: NASA Mars Fact Sheet
use: Mars/Earth solar irradiance ratio is 0.431. The game uses an explicitly simplified 0.85 cruise generation factor for balance. This is not an orbital or surface power model.

title: NASA Ames Trajectory Browser
use: The v11 file attributes 272/288-day routes and delta-v to this browser. Exact query/export was not supplied: these scenario values remain unverified, not certified trajectories.

title: ESA Mars Express · signal delay
use: About 4–24 minutes one way. The displayed linear interpolation is illustrative. Timed decisions represent onboard autonomy, not instant commands from Earth.

title: Bogo et al. (2017) · diapause and colony initiation
use: Mating status and pre-diapause weight affected outcomes in terrestrial rearing. Corrects the v11 misattribution of DOI 10.1007/s13592-017-0529-z to Alford (1969). Does not validate space transport.

title: Smithsonian · STS-41-C bee enclosure
use: Honeybees were studied in orbit; this is not evidence for dormant bumblebee queens on a Mars voyage.

title: JPL · Concept Maturity Levels
use: Design reviews are inspired by maturity levels. Grants and approval criteria are fictional.

title: Model assumptions and art credits
use: All credit prices, payload limits, launcher bus power, linear delta-v penalty, events and risk thresholds are fictional. 2.5 °C and 70% RH are inherited design targets, not a validated space protocol. Human travel, greenhouse and Nobel ending are imagined fiction.
